title: Community Plugins Bring PlayStation and Xbox Interfaces to Steam Deck
snippet: Community-made plugins available on Decky Loader can replace parts of SteamOS Game Mode with console-style layouts modeled on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S dashboards.

title: Next-Gen Console Pricing Debate for PS6 and Xbox Next
snippet: Industry analysts debate whether next-generation consoles will exceed $1,000 due to rising memory and silicon fabrication costs.

title: Valve SteamOS Expansion for Third-Party Handhelds
snippet: Valve continues rolling out official SteamOS support for third-party handheld gaming PCs and portable gaming hardware.

title: Nintendo Switch 2 Ecosystem and Physical Media
snippet: Nintendo confirms cross-generational digital libraries and game compatibility as players prepare for the next platform cycle.

title: The John Ternus Foldable iPhone Reality
snippet: Apple released the foldable iPhone under CEO John Ternus, but repair anxiety is peaking.
